protocol.analysis: For each six-run palindrome block, compare mean log RTF of candidate with default. Average run position equal across conditions within each block. Report all six block ratios, geometric mean, and exploratory t interval across blocks; drift, nonlinear trends and desktop noise remain possible. No sequential stopping based on results.

balanced.validation: All 36 runs EOS, same native hash/config hash/input and output sample counts/Float32 hashes; ordinary Node. Reports are preserved in local experiment directories.
balanced.limitations: Palindrome cancels linear ordinal-position drift only. Six blocks are a small serial sample; exploratory log-t intervals do not prove equivalence or control nonlinear heat/background/carry-over.

probes.physical: proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4; observed cumulative high-water, may miss final exit-time peak
probes.sourceStreamingHashNote: Old pairs and two initial long runs read addon into one temporary Buffer; balanced runs and later long runs use streaming addon hashing. Compare within each series, not small footprint changes across harness versions.

interruption.reason: Stop contaminated default long control after observing heavy Chrome renderer CPU load; user now explicitly provides quiet window; preserve partial artifacts, not an acceptance result.
